what: One row per verified packet family: the verdict, the obligation it turned on, the exact blocker or defect, the exact evidence, and who owns the next step.

supersedes.why: Those rows recorded an absent private Master Library, not a packet. The library was restored and every family was re-evaluated, so the environment-only results are retired and must not be cited as verdicts.

sevenSchemasNormalised: The shards returned the verdict reason under stopReason, decisiveFailure, rowStop, finding or blocker, and the proof obligations as an object in four shards and an array in three. This ledger is the single shape; the returns are unchanged underneath it.
doNotSendAllSeventeen: Only the rows classed GENUINE_NARROW_LEGAL_QUESTION are counsel's. The rest are a missing fee schedule, a missing state legal-design review or an unbound family: sending them to Lawrence would spend the one reviewer nothing else can replace on questions a fee schedule or a Captain binding answers.
commercialPosture: A PASS proves a packet was built and verified as specified. It opens no commercial route and approves no output; COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN stays 0 until PASS plus output approval plus product-path proof.
